scope: Official supplementary references for explicit source qualifications. The lecture remains the course source; these are not extra slide coverage or independently verified question answers.

calculus.locator: Fermat's theorem; x^3 counterexample; endpoint extrema
calculus.finding: Derivative zero is a necessary interior differentiable-extremum condition, not sufficient; endpoints must be checked.

ga.locator: R2026b comparison table and operator definitions
ga.finding: Population-based stochastic search can address nonsmooth problems, but may fail to converge to a local or global minimum.

crossover.finding: Blend gamma includes minus alpha. Unbounded SBX uses two inverse-CDF branches and linear midpoint-preserving child expressions; the crowding index controls spread.

selection.finding: Raw roulette scores cannot directly handle nonpositive fitness or minimization. Tournament chooses the best among sampled aspirants.

binomial.locator: Binomial distribution probability mass function and mean
binomial.finding: Independent identical Bernoulli trials give P(K=k)=choose(n,k)p^k(1-p)^(n-k) and mean np. An expectation is not a realized count.

floating.locator: Representation error and finite binary precision
floating.finding: Ordinary binary floating-point representations have finite precision. Direct real encoding does not imply exact arbitrary real arithmetic.
